player.name: Sable Vey
player.title: Archivist of the Broken Moon
player.trait: Wins by binding memory into law.

scenes.name: Velis Atrium
scenes.detail: A flooded opera floor mirrors every motion in fractured moon glass.
scenes.modifier: Bulwark moves land harder while the chamber is calm.

scenes.name: Ash Balcony
scenes.detail: A suspended promenade where ember choirs distort every promise into spectacle.
scenes.modifier: Trickster moves gain extra pressure when either side is shaken.

scenes.name: Starless Well
scenes.detail: A vertical sanctum where eclipse rituals make every risk louder and more volatile.
scenes.modifier: Eclipse moves spike when tension passes 60.

duelist.name: Sir Alistair
duelist.title: Sun-Bound Guardian
duelist.trait: Rewards learning the basics of stance and guard.

enemyArchetypes.description: A tutorial rival who telegraphs direct force and guard windows.

duelist.name: Ilex Ra
duelist.title: Prince of the Ember Choir
duelist.trait: Pressures with counters and momentum swings.

enemyArchetypes.description: Punishes predictable patterns and forces stance adaptation.

duelist.name: Morgana
duelist.title: Whisperer of the Void
duelist.trait: Stacks pressure, burns resolve, and turns long fights against you.

enemyArchetypes.description: Boss archetype with status stacking and high-tension eclipse plays.

moves.name: Glass Oath
moves.incantation: Bind the arena to one undeniable truth.
moves.summary: Steady opening strike that counters trickster pressure.

moves.name: Warding Verse
moves.incantation: Layer a measured hymn between yourself and harm.
moves.summary: Defensive line that clears burning and gains focus.

moves.name: Iron Refrain
moves.incantation: Repeat the vow until panic cracks first.
moves.summary: Reliable follow-up that spikes when you are already guarded.

moves.name: Mirror Feint
moves.incantation: Turn the rival legend against itself.
moves.summary: Applies shaken and punishes rigid bulwark setups.

moves.name: Ghost Lattice
moves.incantation: Let the enemy walk into the shape of their own mistake.
moves.summary: Low damage control move that gains value after focus.

moves.name: Choir Vein
moves.incantation: Fracture the enemy cadence with a smiling lie.
moves.summary: Disruptive counter that clears guard before a bigger swing.

moves.name: Eclipse Refrain
moves.incantation: Invoke the old sky and let the chamber choose.
moves.summary: High-risk eclipse play that thrives at high tension.

moves.name: Sunless Applause
moves.incantation: Summon omen from the balcony shadows.
moves.summary: Boss-style pressure move that scales with burning targets.

moves.name: Void Suture
moves.incantation: Stitch dread and focus into a single finishing thread.
moves.summary: Precision finisher that converts focus into heavy resolve damage.

battleDefinitions.label: Battle 1
battleDefinitions.tutorialHint: Start by learning stance advantage and the value of guarded turns.

battleDefinitions.label: Battle 2
battleDefinitions.tutorialHint: Watch for shaken and counter windows. Repeating the same move gets punished here.

battleDefinitions.label: Boss Battle
battleDefinitions.tutorialHint: Use focus and status timing carefully. The boss thrives if tension runs high for too long.

initialChronicle.title: The sanctum opens
initialChronicle.summary: Sable enters the sanctum with the archive sigil lit. The first battle will teach whether restraint or spectacle rules the chamber.
initialChronicle.oracleLine: The first claim will define what kind of truth this arena accepts.
initialChronicle.sceneShift: A flooded opera floor mirrors every motion in fractured moon glass.
